en-US.title: A-Claro
en-US.subtitle: See allergy clearly
en-US.description:
A-Claro is an Aclearo allergy companion app. Offline-first diary, explainable product scanner, pollen and air context, SOS passport, and doctor-ready PDF reports — in 6 languages.

A-Claro helps you see allergy information clearly: scan barcodes, log symptoms, track environmental triggers, and share structured reports with your clinician.

MEDICAL DISCLAIMER: A-Claro is not a medical device and does not diagnose, treat, or prevent disease. Information is educational and does not replace professional medical advice. Always consult a qualified clinician. In an emergency call local emergency services.

МЕДИЦИНСКИЙ DISCLAIMER: A-Claro не является медицинским изделием, не ставит диагноз и не назначает лечение. Информация носит рекомендательный характер и не заменяет консультацию врача. При угрозе жизни звоните 103.
